Iris: Thanks for coming to the runtime segment. I'll field brief follow-ups here.
Marco: Will per-route batching be ready for demos in 3 weeks?
Iris: Yes infra API ready ~3w, console in beta later. Annotations work now.
Tess: Kernel prewarm—any rough numbers for first-token improvement?
Rohit: Prototype showed ~40-60ms median reduction on long-context runs.
BuildBot: Canary deploy kernel-prewarm started at 1819990060; 3/4 nodes healthy.
Marco: Any guidance for latency profile config to share with customers?
Rohit: Quick pasteable:

policy: latency-sensitive
max_batch: 6
max_wait_ms: 8
prewarm: true
pool: isolated

Iris: We'll add telemetry for prewarm_hits and prewarm_rss_delta to Console. Follow-ups in doc.
